title: What is the numerical value of each of these expressions?
description: Six expressions with powers are worked out by finding each power first and then multiplying. The signs of the minus numbers are found by counting minus signs, and two answers are checked.
teaching_notes: One idea: work out each power first, find its sign by counting minus signs, and only then multiply. Watch for students who multiply the base by the exponent instead of working out the power.

video_script.why: The child can work out five to the power four step by step and now works out six expressions that multiply a number by a power, or two powers, some with minus numbers.
video_script.substitution: Six new expressions, each solved by finding its powers first and then multiplying.
video_script.anchor: the six expressions on the board, each power circled and worked out beside it
video_script.payoff_line: The last value is minus three crore twenty lakh

final_answer.spoken: two thousand; three hundred ninety two; seven hundred sixty eight; two hundred twenty five; ninety thousand; and minus three crore twenty lakh

video_script.design: One idea: find each power first, then multiply. The six expressions stay on the board all video; the last product is left open until the answer; the check redoes two products another way.

<bookmark mark='ask'/>What is the numerical value of each one?

beats.on_screen: To find: the numerical value of each expression
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the numerical value of each expression.

marks.one: the powers are circled in the first two

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, work out each power first, the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Ten cubed is one thousand, and two times one thousand is two thousand.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Seven squared is forty nine, and two cubed is eight.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>Forty nine times eight is three hundred ninety two.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, four to the power four is sixteen times sixteen.
That is two hundred fifty six.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>Three times two hundred fifty six is seven hundred sixty eight.
<bookmark mark='minus'/>Minus three multiplied by itself is nine, and minus five multiplied by itself is twenty five.
<bookmark mark='nine'/>Nine times twenty five is two hundred twenty five.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, three squared is nine, and ten to the power four is ten thousand.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>Nine times ten thousand is ninety thousand.

beats.on_screen: (−2)⁵: five minus signs, odd, so −32; (−10)⁶: six minus signs, even, so 1000000; −32 × 1000000

marks.four: (−2)⁵ is marked five minus signs, odd, so negative
marks.ten: (−10)⁶ is marked six minus signs, even, so positive
marks.lakh: 10⁶ = 1000000 and −32 × 1000000 is written with the result left open

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step four, minus two to the power five has five minus signs, an odd count.
<bookmark mark='thirtytwo'/>Two to the power five is thirty two, so the value is minus thirty two.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>Minus ten to the power six has six minus signs, an even count.
<bookmark mark='lakh'/>Ten to the power six is ten lakh, so the value is positive.
Minus thirty two times ten lakh is left to find.

marks.sign: negative × positive = negative is written beside the last expression

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>Step five, check the second by fifty times eight, which is four hundred.
Four hundred minus eight is three hundred ninety two.
<bookmark mark='third'/>Check the third by splitting two hundred fifty six into two hundred fifty and six.
<bookmark mark='parts'/>Three times two hundred fifty is seven hundred fifty, and three times six is eighteen.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Seven hundred fifty plus eighteen is seven hundred sixty eight.
<bookmark mark='sign'/>For the last one, a negative times a positive is negative.
<bookmark mark='a1'/>The last value is minus three crore twenty lakh.
<bookmark mark='a2'/>The first three are two thousand, three hundred ninety two and seven hundred sixty eight.
<bookmark mark='a3'/>The next two are two hundred twenty five and ninety thousand.
